WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    account.district_id,
    district.A3 as region,
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
  GROUP BY account.district_id, district.A3
),
with_region_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    region,
    account_count,
    AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as region_average
  FROM district_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    region,
    account_count,
    account_count - region_average as exceeds_region_average
  FROM with_region_avg
  WHERE account_count > region_average
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    region,
    account_count,
    exceeds_region_average,
    account_count / AVG(account_count) OVER () as ratio
  FROM above_average
),
top_10 AS (
  SELECT ratio FROM with_ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  region,
  account_count,
  exceeds_region_average,
  ratio
FROM with_ratio
WHERE ratio >= (SELECT MIN(ratio) FROM top_10)
ORDER BY ratio DESC
